title: Inverse Coordinate Transform (Five-Phase)
text: Implement dqxy0 to abcde transform, 2 inputs, 1 output; {Phase-a axis alignment} sets the dqxy0 reference frame. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: dqxy0
ports.summary: Direct, quadrature, x, y, and zero components vector

ports.name: abcde
ports.summary: a -, b -, c -, d -, and e -phase components vector

params.name: Phase-a axis alignment
params.values: dqxy0 reference frame alignment Q-axis (default) | D-axis
